text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to copy human intelligence. It helps computers learn, think, and make decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type, using large neural networks to solve hard problems. We use AI every day, often without noticing. For example, it suggests movies on Netflix, helps with voice search, and improves maps on our phones. AI is also used in hospitals and banks. It is changing our world quickly.
